hero.subtext: waiTime fills cancelled appointments by instantly notifying patients on the waitlist — the first to confirm gets the appointment.

problem.title: The hidden cost of cancellations
problem.subtitle: Empty slots aren't just an inconvenience — they represent direct revenue loss and delayed care for patients who need it.
problem.stat1Desc: Studies at Swiss outpatient clinics report missed appointment rates between 11.4% and 15.8% — every one is a lost slot.
problem.stat2Desc: Each unfilled cancellation represents direct revenue that disappears unless the slot is actively recovered.
problem.stat3Desc: While slots go empty, patients on waitlists wait months for appointments that could have been theirs.

howItWorks.title: Fully automated slot filling
howItWorks.subtitle: waiTime acts as an invisible assistant, monitoring schedules and acting the moment an opening appears
howItWorks.step1Desc: When a cancellation is recorded in the clinic's system, waiTime picks it up instantly and starts the match process.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Not every waitlisted patient fits every slot. waiTime filters by each patient's preferences and surfaces only those who actually match.
howItWorks.step3Desc: An SMS or email goes out to matching patients. First to respond secures the slot. Everyone else is notified it's been filled. The clinic dashboard updates automatically.

ehrs.title: Built for Swiss outpatient workflows
ehrs.subtitle: waiTime connects to the practice management system already in use at the clinic and runs quietly in the background. No data is ever stored on our servers — your patient records stay exactly where they are.
ehrs.compatible: Compatible with leading Swiss EHR systems
ehrs.note: Patient data never leaves the clinic's system. waiTime receives only what it needs to find a match, processes it, and discards it. Nothing is stored on our end.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: Plans scale with the size of your practice.

team.title: Meet the team
team.subtitle: A team of developers from ZHAW Zürich, building the infrastructure Swiss clinics are missing.
